subject.title: Feature request: Auto-send intent/acknowledgment text message before agent processing

question: Should OpenClaw solve pre-processing acknowledgement text as shared messages.ackText config, a non-terminal send-and-continue plugin/channel hook, or only channel-specific placeholder features?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the correct owner boundary affects config compatibility, plugin SDK semantics, and per-channel delivery behavior.

options.title: Shared default-off ackText config
options.body: Add one global/channel/account acknowledgement-text config with explicit scope and lifecycle semantics, then wire supported channels through existing delivery paths.

options.title: New non-terminal hook
options.body: Expose a typed hook that can send an interim message and continue processing, leaving policy to plugins at the cost of plugin API compatibility work.

options.title: Channel-specific placeholders only
options.body: Keep this broad issue as a cluster tracker and solve Slack, Telegram, Discord, and other surfaces independently where channel UX differs.

recommendation.title: Shared default-off ackText config
recommendation.body: Add one global/channel/account acknowledgement-text config with explicit scope and lifecycle semantics, then wire supported channels through existing delivery paths.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent source reply delivery, messages config, and cross-channel acknowledgement lifecycle work make steipete the strongest routing candidate for the product/API choice.
